The new Delta Hybrid screw blowers - Small sizes. Big difference in design. 🎯
 
With the new Delta Hybrid D11S and D16S, AERZEN is expanding the lower flow rate range and creating more flexibility for efficient process air generation and allows for precise adjustment to the actual air demand.
 
💡 Why is this exciting?
 
Precise adaptation to actual demand is especially important in smaller capacity ranges. Over-sized units waste energy. Too narrow a control range limits flexibility.
 
The new sizes bring Delta Hybrid performance to finely graded capacity ranges:
 
🔹 D11S with up to 780 m³/h air flow
🔹 D16S from 100 to 1,020 m³/h
🔹 Extended control range up to 1:5
🔹 100% oil- and PFAS-free process air
🔹 Up to 37% energy savings compared to conventional blowers
 
Added to this are direct drive, an integrated frequency converter, AERtronic control, and a compact plug-and-play design.
 
For plant engineers and operators, this means: greater flexibility, lower lifecycle costs, and a solution that can be adapted more precisely to process requirements.
 
🔎 Read more about the new D11S and D16S models in the current COM·PRESS issue. ⬇️

A great example of how smart wastewater treatment solutions can help meet growing capacity and performance demands. Even where space is limited.
 
MBBR technology offers an interesting approach by combining a compact footprint with the flexibility to handle varying treatment loads. And as this project also shows, efficient aeration plays an important role in the overall system. From our perspective, the greatest efficiency potential comes from looking beyond individual components and considering aeration as an integrated system. From oxygen demand and air generation to distribution and intelligent control.
 
Great to see solutions like this being put into practice. Thanks to Veolia | Water Tech UK for sharing the insights!

💨 Process air is no minor detail. It determines product purity, safety, and efficiency.

We’re at POWTECH TECHNOPHARM in Nuremberg. There, we’re showcasing our solutions for the reliable and cost-effective processing and pneumatic conveying of powders, granules, and bulk materials.

The focus is on:
🔹 Efficient blowers and compressors for demanding conveying processes
🔹 Energy- and resource-efficient process air solutions
🔹 Oil-free and desiccant-free process air for sensitive products
🔹 Safe solutions for potentially explosive atmospheres
🔹 Customized concepts tailored to your application and process requirements

Whether in the food, pharmaceutical, chemical, or building materials industries: Together, we develop solutions that make processes safer, more efficient, and more cost-effective.

Secure your ticket and visit us at POWTECH TECHNOPHARM 2026.👇🏻

📍 Nuremberg, Hall 9 | Stand 420
📅 September 29–October 1, 2026
🎟️ https://lnkd.in/d97W2dxQ

We look forward to seeing you! 🤝🏻

⚓ Just a few days left until SMM 2026 in Hamburg.
 
The maritime industry faces a number of challenges: greater efficiency, lower emissions, operational safety, and future-proof technologies for ship and port operations.
 
That’s exactly what we’d like to discuss with you. Visit AERZEN at SMM Hamburg from September 1–4, 2026, and learn how AERZEN solutions can help reduce operating costs, optimize processes, and achieve energy efficiency goals.
 
Always on Course. Our focus areas:
🔹 Air lubrication systems to reduce water resistance and improve energy efficiency
🔹 Solutions for onboard water treatment
🔹 Anti-heeling systems for greater stability and safety during operation
🔹 Boil-off gas solutions for modern LNG applications
 
Let’s talk about your current challenges together. 💬
Take this opportunity to speak with our experts in person and discover our concrete solutions for your maritime applications.
 
📍 Hamburg | Hall A3 | Booth 333
📅 September 1–4, 2026
 
We look forward to seeing you there! 🌊
